top_signals.title: Warren Buffett’s $150 Billion Legacy Falls to His Children
top_signals.summary:
Warren Buffett’s three children are preparing to take responsibility for one of the world’s biggest fortunes.
Buffett is worth about $150 billion and has pledged to give away the vast majority of his wealth.
When he dies, Susie, Howard and Peter Buffett will have to agree unanimously on how to give away what remains.
The siblings already back very different causes, from early education to food security and conflict mitigation.
But they still haven’t decided how they’ll distribute the fortune, with Susie Buffett saying: “We don’t know yet.” Charlie Wells joins Caroline Hepker and Stephen Carroll on Bloomberg Radio to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
